Hi Marta — thanks, and welcome.

Short answer: we support both delivery methods; recommendation depends on your AP workflow. Options: 

1) PDF email copy (fastest): we email a PDF to ap@greenvalehealth.com with structured header fields in the first page (PO, remit-to, VAT). Good if you want human review + AP inboxing.

2) Portal enrollment: we invite your AP team to our billing portal. Portal provides consolidated monthlies, invoice search, and CSV export. We can still email copies if you want.

3) API/XML push (recommended for automation): Redwood can POST an invoice XML/JSON payload to an endpoint you provide, or send signed webhook pushes to a URL. Payload contains line-level PO mapping, VAT fields, remittance details. Sample XML attached (redwood-invoice-xml-sample.xml). Authentication: bearer token OR mutual TLS on request — we can match Greenvale's preference.

Notes: 
- We can include vendor VAT/EIN fields and a remittance_reference element that maps to your PO.
- For the pilot, if you prefer API, Connor (cc'd) will set up the webhook and share a test endpoint and auth key. If you prefer PDF email + portal backup, Kimberly will trigger the portal invite.

Next steps I propose: 
- Marta: confirm preferred path (API push vs PDF email + portal) and whether you want a temp test endpoint.
- If API: share a test endpoint and preferred auth method; we'll run two test invoices.
- If email/portal: confirm the target email(s) and the person to receive the portal invite (name + email).

Linking HubSpot so we capture the preference: https://hubspot.example/deal/GVH-2026-09-001

Best,

Irene Choi
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-invoice-xml-sample.xml (xml); remittance-instructions-template.csv (csv)
